Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well. We are preparing our Q4 cash plan and need a firm withdrawal/runway schedule for the annual prepay (DL-5891) so we can align the treasury sweep. Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the PO. Attaching the current proposed drawdown runway and the signed SOW. High level: we recommend monthly tranche invoices on the 1st of each month starting Oct 1, 2026 (12 equal tranches), with a final reconciliation invoice in Oct 2027 that nets usage over/under.

VAT/tax handling: Redwood will issue EU VAT invoices to Brightlane EU (please confirm the EU VAT number you want on the invoices). For the UK we can either invoice via Redwood UK or Brightlane US depending on your preferred tax reporting flow; see the country-tax file attached with both options.

Next steps: if that cadence works, please confirm the remit account for wire advice and whether you need monthly remittance files (we can provide CS-ready CSVs).

Attachments: prepay_drawdown_schedule.xlsx, BRIGHTLANE_SOW_v2.pdf, Brightlane_TaxIDs.csv

Thanks,

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Brightlane drawdown cadence + tax routing (need quick confirmation)

Monica / Ben — forwarding Laura’s ask. Proposed behavior:
- Invoice cadence: 12 monthly invoices on 1st of month (Oct 1 2026–Sep 1 2027) + reconciliation in Oct 2027.
- Collection ops: wire details to be set per remit; if they want ACH/SEPA we need banking matrix.
- VAT routing: preference is to invoice Brightlane EU for EU VAT (requires their VAT number). For UK — recommend Redwood UK issuance to avoid Brightlane US reclaim complexity unless they prefer otherwise.

Questions:
1) Monica — can you confirm our template for the monthly remittance CSV (columns/start-of-month balances)? Ben mentioned a new field in ledger tagging for prepay buckets — will that be available by Oct?
2) Ben — if we stagger invoices rather than equal tranches (they asked about runway smoothing), can we produce the amortization schedule that shows token burn vs invoice amount?

I’ll wait til EOD for quick replies so we can get Laura a locked schedule.

— Priyom
